Busy restaurant operators shouldn't have to wear the marketing hat, too. In 2026, that changes.


Meet[Toast IQ Grow](https://pos.toasttab.com/products/toast-iq-grow) : Toast's AI marketing agent, using your own POS data to build campaigns that actually know your business—your menu, your regulars, your slow Tuesdays. It plugs your marketing and advertising directly into your ordering channels, so more of your traffic comes directly to your first-party ordering channels, helping you reduce third-party commissions.


This is your guide to Toast IQ Grow, an AI-powered solution built specifically for restaurant marketing.


## What is Toast IQ Grow?


[Toast IQ Grow](https://pos.toasttab.com/products/toast-iq-grow) is an automated marketing package for restaurants that pairs together a specialized AI Marketing Agent with dedicated human support to drive customers directly to your ordering channels, with less manual work.


Toast IQ Grow is built specifically for the busy operator and is built directly into your POS to learn from your business’ transactions.

### How the AI marketing agent works


Toast IQ Grow connects directly to a restaurant's native[Toast POS](https://pos.toasttab.com/restaurant-pos) data, sales history, and[Guest CRM](https://pos.toasttab.com/products/guest-crm) , and can incorporate local market insights like seasonal slowdowns, all without relying on third-party data syncs, since it lives inside the Toast ecosystem.


From there, it works two ways. Proactively, it identifies slowdowns or opportunities in your sales data and automatically drafts campaigns across email, SMS, social media, and digital ads, segmenting your Guest CRM to target specific diners — lapsed guests, frequent lunch regulars, and more. On demand, operators can type natural-language requests like "Draft an email campaign for our summer sale" or "Draft an SMS campaign for slow Tuesday lunch," and the AI Marketing Agent builds it from there.


Either way, Toast IQ Grow creates drafts and asks for permission before implementation. It will never send or schedule a campaign on its own. Every draft generates a link where the operator can review, edit, and manually trigger or schedule the send.


### The human side: Your dedicated marketing success manager


Every Toast IQ Grow account includes a dedicated Marketing Success Manager (MSM) — a real person, not a shared support queue. The AI Marketing Agent drafts and segments; your MSM reviews that work alongside you, aligning it with your brand voice and guidelines, and makes sure nothing goes out the door without your approval.

### Let AI (and a real person) handle your restaurant marketing


Restaurant marketing in 2026 has often come down to a trade-off: hand it off to an AI tool and hope it "gets" your business, or hire (and pay for) a human agency that actually understands your regulars but can't move at algorithm speed. Toast IQ Grow skips the trade-off entirely.


Toast IQ Grow is built to uniquely combine advanced AI with dedicated human support. Clover, Square, and SpotOn offer one or the other—not both. Toast IQ Grow's AI marketing agent learns from your actual POS data, not a generic template, so campaigns reflect your menu, your week nights, and your regulars from day one.


Dedicated human support means there's always someone who can course-correct, answer questions, and make sure the strategy stays sharp as your business changes. And because it's built into your existing ordering channels, the guests it brings in land directly with you, not with a third-party app taking a cut.


Ready to see what AI-powered, human-backed marketing can do for your restaurant?[Learn more about Toast IQ Grow](https://pos.toasttab.com/products/toast-iq-grow) .


### FAQs


**What are AI tools for restaurant marketing?**


AI marketing tools for restaurants use technology to automate tasks like drafting emails, building SMS campaigns, segmenting guest lists, and running social or digital ads — often based on sales data, guest history, or local trends. Some tools generate content from a simple prompt; others, like Toast IQ Grow, go further by learning directly from a restaurant's POS data and pairing that AI output with human review before anything goes out.


**How do restaurants use AI?**


Beyond marketing,[restaurants use AI](https://pos.toasttab.com/blog/on-the-line/ai-for-restaurants) to forecast sales and staffing needs, manage inventory and reduce waste, personalize menu recommendations, automate guest communications (like reservation confirmations or review responses), and analyze performance data to spot trends a busy operator might miss.


**Is AI worth it for a small or independent restaurant?**


For independent operators without a dedicated marketing team, AI can close a real gap — turning guest and sales data into campaigns without requiring hours of manual work or an agency retainer.
